Unlock 1 · Unit 6Unit Review

Comparing Quantities & Comparative Adjectives

more · fewer · less · taller · busier · more expensive · better · worse

★Quick Rule Box
More
Use more with:
  • countable nouns: more rooms, floors, visitors
  • uncountable nouns: more money, information, traffic
Fewer
Use fewer with countable nouns:
  • fewer rooms
  • fewer visitors
  • fewer elevators
Less
Use less with uncountable nouns:
  • less money
  • less traffic
  • less information
  • less space
Comparative adjectives
  • tall → taller than
  • small → smaller than
  • busy → busier than
  • beautiful → more beautiful than
  • expensive → more expensive than
  • good → better than
  • bad → worse than
Part AComparing quantities: more / fewer / less … than
01Exercise 1 — More, fewer, or less?

Complete each sentence with more, fewer, or less.

1A large apartment usually has ___ rooms than a small apartment.more·fewer·less
2A small house often has ___ space than a large house.more·fewer·less
3This building has ___ elevators than the one next door. (this building: 4 · next door: 6)more·fewer·less
4A modern office may have ___ technology than an old office.more·fewer·less
5A small apartment usually costs ___ money than a large apartment.more·fewer·less
6This hotel has ___ rooms than the hotel across the street. (this hotel: 80 · across the street: 120)more·fewer·less
7A quiet neighborhood usually has ___ traffic than the city center.more·fewer·less
8The shopping mall has ___ visitors on weekdays than on weekends.more·fewer·less
9This building has ___ information on its website than the other one. (this website: 10 pages · the other: 4 pages)more·fewer·less
10Our new classroom has ___ chairs than the old classroom. (new: 30 · old: 20)more·fewer·less

06Exercise 6 — Correct the mistakes

Each sentence has a mistake. Write the correct sentence.

1This building is more tall than that building.
This building is taller than that building.
2My apartment is more small than yours.
My apartment is smaller than yours.
3The city center is busyer than my neighborhood.
The city center is busier than my neighborhood.
4This hotel is expensiver than the other hotel.
This hotel is more expensive than the other hotel.
5The new building is modern than the old building.
The new building is more modern than the old building.
6My new apartment is gooder than my old one.
My new apartment is better than my old one.
7The traffic today is more bad than yesterday.
The traffic today is worse than yesterday.
8This street has less cars than the main road.
This street has fewer cars than the main road.
9The new hotel has fewer information on its website.
The new hotel has less information on its website.
10This apartment costs fewer money than the other one.
This apartment costs less money than the other one.

08Exercise 8 — Write comparisons

Use the information to write a complete sentence.

1Building A: 20 floors · Building B: 12 floors (start: Building A)
Building A has more floors than Building B.
2Apartment A: 3 bedrooms · Apartment B: 5 bedrooms (start: Apartment A)
Apartment A has fewer bedrooms than Apartment B.
3House A: $300,000 · House B: $450,000 (start: House A)
House A costs less money than House B.
4Street A: very busy · Street B: quiet (start: Street A)
Street A is busier than Street B.
5Hotel A: modern · Hotel B: old (start: Hotel A)
Hotel A is more modern than Hotel B.
6Building A: 4 elevators · Building B: 7 elevators (start: Building A)
Building A has fewer elevators than Building B.
7City A: a lot of traffic · Town B: little traffic (start: City A)
City A has more traffic than Town B.
8Apartment A: beautiful · Apartment B: simple (start: Apartment A)
Apartment A is more beautiful than Apartment B.
9House A: good condition · House B: bad condition (start: House A)
House A is better than House B.
10Road A: bad traffic · Road B: light traffic (start: The traffic on Road A)
The traffic on Road A is worse than the traffic on Road B.
